description:
Tune in to Minecraft Live on May 30 at 5:30pm CET / 8:30 am PST, live from TwitchCon!

It’s only been a few months since our last Minecraft LIVE but we’re back with a bonus show. Broadcast from Twitchcon in Rotterdam, we’ll be featuring sneak peeks into the latest game drops, getting exclusive insights from the developers, and more!
title: Minecraft LIVE Official Trailer - TwitchCon May 2026
